security_audit.summary: All 19 static findings are false positives because they identify Markdown formatting or an audit KPI. A separate low-severity finding notes that intrusive testing and phishing simulations lack explicit authorization and scope requirements.

content.user_title: Plan and Conduct ISO 27001 ISMS Audits
content.value_statement: ISMS teams need consistent audit plans, evidence reviews, and control assessments. This skill structures ISO 27001 audit work and prepares clear findings and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Structures risk-based ISMS audit programs and schedules.
Defines ISO 27001 audit scopes, priorities, and testing approaches.
Organizes evidence collection and security control effectiveness assessments.
Supports certification readiness, surveillance audits, and regulatory inspection preparation.
Frames risk-ranked findings, compliance summaries, and improvement recommendations.
limitations: Provides guidance only and does not replace an accredited certification body or qualified auditor.
Does not execute vulnerability scans, penetration tests, or automated control checks.
Included scripts, references, and assets are placeholders and do not implement the named audit resources.
Requires organization-specific scope, risk, evidence, and regulatory context for reliable conclusions.

use_cases.title: Build an Annual Audit Program
use_cases.description: Prioritize audit topics, set frequencies, assign competencies, and connect the schedule to security risks.

use_cases.title: Assess Control Effectiveness
use_cases.description: Prepare evidence requests, interviews, samples, and test criteria for technical and administrative controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Certification
use_cases.description: Review readiness, organize Stage 1 evidence, identify gaps, and prioritize corrective actions before external assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Audit Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 27001 internal audit checklist for [scope]. Include objectives, evidence requests, interview roles, and expected control results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a focused internal audit.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Risk-Based Audit Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a risk-based ISMS audit plan for [organization]. Use [risk register details], prior findings, and audit frequency constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning an annual or multiyear audit program.

prompt_templates.title: Design Control Effectiveness Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Design control effectiveness tests for [controls]. Separate design and operating effectiveness, then define samples, evidence, pass criteria, and finding severity.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when detailed control verification is required.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Certification Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [organization] for ISO 27001 certification readiness using [evidence summary]. Identify gaps, root causes, risk, remediation owners, and Stage 1 priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a certification or surveillance audit.

output_examples.input: Create a risk-based audit plan for a cloud service provider with unresolved access control findings.
output: Quarterly access control and identity governance audits receive the highest priority.
Evidence includes privileged access reviews, joiner and leaver records, authentication settings, and prior corrective actions.
The plan assigns independent technical reviewers and tracks closure against defined deadlines.

output_examples.input: Write a finding for inconsistent quarterly access reviews.
output_examples.output: Access reviews were completed for two of four sampled quarters. This weakens timely privilege removal. Assign an owner and verify complete reviews monthly.

output_examples.input: Summarize certification readiness from an evidence review with missing internal audit records.
output_examples.output: Readiness is incomplete because the organization cannot demonstrate an effective internal audit program. Complete the audit cycle and retain findings, actions, and closure evidence.

best_practices: Provide the audit scope, applicable requirements, risk register, and prior findings before requesting a plan.
Separate control design, implementation, and operating effectiveness when defining tests and conclusions.
Validate generated findings against objective evidence and assign accountable remediation owners.
anti_patterns: Do not claim certification or compliance from incomplete evidence.
Do not run penetration tests or social engineering exercises without written authorization and an approved scope.
Do not accept generic recommendations that lack risk, ownership, deadlines, or verification criteria.

faq.question: Does this skill certify an organization to ISO 27001?
faq.answer: No. It supports audit preparation and assessment, but certification requires an accredited certification body.

faq.question: Can it create an internal audit plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the ISMS scope, risk priorities, previous findings, available auditors, and required audit frequency.

faq.question: Does it perform technical security testing?
faq.answer: No. It can structure authorized test plans and evidence criteria, but it does not run scanners or penetration testing tools.

faq.question: Which standards does it cover?
faq.answer: Its main focus is ISO 27001 and ISO 27002. It also discusses HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST, and sector requirements.

faq.question: What information improves the audit output?
faq.answer: Provide scope, assets, risks, controls, legal requirements, incidents, prior findings, evidence, and stakeholder roles.

faq.question: Can it prepare certification audit materials?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize readiness reviews, evidence requests, gap summaries, corrective actions, and Stage 1 preparation.
